subject: Audit log extract — sample formats & region mapping questions
messages:
From: Alex Berger <alex.berger@finvero.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit extracts — formats + region mapping

Hi Marcus / Neha,

Thanks for taking this call last week. Two quick follow-ups from our compliance team as we scope the handover for Finvero's audit logs:  

1) Format: our auditors prefer columnar Parquet where possible, but they can ingest JSONL too. Can you confirm which formats Redwood can deliver for audit/access logs?
2) Region mapping: we need a mapping file that shows for each log partition (tenant, date range) the originating region and whether any cross-border routing occurred. Do you provide that as part of the extract?
3) Retention window for exported slices: if we request a 90-day extract next week, what's the SLA and how long will you hold the export staging before deletion?

Also looping in our legal contact, Jenna Park, in case there are contractual notes.

Appreciate a short summary and any sample manifests you can share.

Best,
Alex
Senior IT Compliance
Finvero

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Berger <alex.berger@finvero.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Jul 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit extracts — formats + region mapping

Alex — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, followed by what I'll attach: a small sample manifest and the current log schema.

1) Formats: We can export audit and access logs in Parquet, JSONL, and compressed CSV. Parquet is our recommended default for large slices because it's much smaller and faster for analytics.
2) Region mapping: Yes — we include a region_metadata.csv with each extract that maps tenant_id / shard / time_range -> origin_region, egress_region (if any), and a note for any routed fallbacks.
3) Retention of export staging: Standard is 72 hours for signed S3 URLs unless you request an extended window. For enterprise customers we can extend to 14 days via a short agreement (we'll attach a draft).

I'm attaching:
- audit_sample_manifest.csv (sample of the region mapping and file checksums)
- log_schema_v2.json (field-level names + typing)
- export_agreement_draft.pdf (optional extension terms for holding exports longer than 72 hours)

Neha — can you add the precise SLA language for the 14-day option? Priyom, see note below about partitioning and checksums — we should include that in the manifest.

Next steps: if Finvero confirms Parquet + 14-day window we can schedule a delivery starting next Wednesday.

Cheers,
Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: log_schema_v2.json (schema snapshot)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Berger <alex.berger@finvero.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Aug 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit extracts — formats + region mapping

Alex / Marcus / Neha — adding a technical note on partitioning and verification so Finvero's ops team knows what to expect.

- Partitioning: Exports are broken into daily parquet files per tenant (tenant_id/date/HH) by default. For high-throughput tenants we further shard by instance id. The audit_sample_manifest.csv shows the file-level metadata.
- Checksums & validation: Each file in the manifest includes MD5 and a row count. We also provide a top-level signed manifest.json that contains a manifest_hash (SHA256 over the concatenated file checksums) to validate completeness.
- Timezones / timestamps: All timestamps are normalized to UTC in the extract and the manifest includes original_zone when events originated outside the tenant's primary region.
- Cross-border routing notes: If a request was served from a non-origin region (fallback), we add a 'routed=true' flag and 'route_reason' text in the manifest. That is what you will see in the egress_region column.

Example manifest line (CSV):
file_name,format,tenant_id,start_ts,end_ts,origin_region,egress_region,md5,records
finvero_audit_20280701_00.parquet,parquet,finvero-123,2028-07-01T00:00:00Z,2028-07-01T00:59:59Z,eu-west-1,eu-west-1,3b9d...,124512

If Finvero needs logs in a different timezone or with original epoch_ms we can include that as an alternate export.

Prio: confirm whether Finvero wants compressed parquet (snappy) or uncompressed for their pipeline. Snappy saves ~60% bandwidth and doesn't affect record counts.

– Priyom
Principal Engineer, Inference Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Berger <alex.berger@finvero.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jenna Park <jenna.park@finvero.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Aug 2028 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit extracts — formats + region mapping

Thanks Marcus / Priyom — this is exactly what we needed. A couple of legal/compliance clarifications from our side before we sign the 14-day staging addendum:  

1) Encryption at rest for staging: will the files in the S3 staging bucket be encrypted with CMEK (customer-managed keys) or Redwood-managed keys? We require CMEK for our regulated workloads.
2) Deletion certification: after the 14-day window we need a deletion certificate (timestamped record) that lists the manifest_hash and confirms the files were removed and objects no longer accessible. Can Redwood provide a verifiable deletion confirmation?
3) Data residency proof: in addition to the region_metadata.csv we sometimes need a short attestation statement for auditors that the files originated in eu-west-1 and were not processed outside the EU.

Jenna — can you confirm if we need contractual language beyond the draft Marcus attached, or if the standard addendum works?

If those three items are possible, we will sign and schedule the extract for Wed 9 Aug.

Best,
Alex

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Berger <alex.berger@finvero.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Aug 2028 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit extracts — formats + region mapping

Alex / Jenna — quick confirmations on the three items:  

1) CMEK: Yes — for enterprise exports we support delivery to a customer-managed S3 bucket with CMEK. We'll provide the bucket policy template and the KMS key ARN mapping in the ramp doc.

2) Deletion certification: We can generate an automated deletion certificate. It will include the manifest_hash, deletion_timestamp (UTC), and a signed statement from Redwood's export system. The certificate will be delivered to the Finvero legal mailbox as a PDF and stored in your secure drive link for 90 days.

3) Residency attestation: We can supply a one-paragraph attestation signed by Redwood's Compliance lead stating the origin regions and whether any processing occurred outside the EU for the requested timeframe. Note: if you require an independent third-party notarized attestation we'll need to scope that separately.

Action items:  
- Jenna / Finvero legal: confirm the CMEK KMS ARN and whether you want snappy-compressed parquet.
- Alex: if you confirm Wed 9 Aug we'll queue the export and send an automated preflight report 24 hours before delivery.
- Neha / Priyom: I'll open a delivery ticket and attach the sample manifest and draft agreement. Priyom — please prepare the deletion-certificate template (example fields above).

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if Jenna wants a walkthrough of the delivery flow.

Regards,
Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
